name: P5 pond (recommended) · ~0.52 ML
notes: 3 m wall about 40 m long holds about 0.5 ML (524 m³) over 444 m². Wall earthworks roughly 743 m³. 0.4 ha drains to it. Small catchment: the easiest kind of in-gully pond; still needs a spillway. About 118 m above the house: a gravity source, but fit a pressure-reducing valve. Computed from 5 m elevation, so check on site.
